beschreibung:
On today’s episode, Arian, PFT and Big T are joined by T-Bob to discuss one of the most controversial figures in American history: John Brown. They get into his radical abolitionism, Bleeding Kansas, the infamous raid on Harpers Ferry, his plan to spark a massive slave uprising, and how his actions helped push an already divided country closer to war.

Plus, they get into everything in the news including, Netflix’s new Stanford Prison Experiment, new uncoverings on the Donald Trump assasination attempt, PFT’s JMU Football Tryout and kickers and much more. Enjoy!
